# third_party

- `hedron_compile_commands_bazel9.patch`: a patch to
  [hedronvision/bazel-compile-commands-extractor](https://github.com/hedronvision/bazel-compile-commands-extractor)
  so it runs on Bazel 9 (which dropped the native `py_binary`). It modifies
  that project's code and is under its license, Apache-2.0, not the
  template's MIT license.
